One changes to 7-Zip 26.04, 2026-10-10

This is an altered build, based on the exact source and commit in SOURCE.json.
The complete upstream source is provided in 7zip-26.04-source.tar.gz; the
corresponding One changes are provided in one-password-codepage.patch and
one-lha-headers.patch, applied in the order recorded in SOURCE.json.
Original copyright and licenses are retained in License.txt and DOC/ in the
source archive (GNU LGPL, unRAR restriction and the other stated licenses).

The ZIP handler accepts a new ISetProperties "pwcp" unsigned integer property
for read-password bytes, separately from the existing filename "cp" property.
Allowed values: 0 (system ACP), 437, 932, 936, 949, 950, 65001 (UTF-8).
The handler default remains CP_ACP. One explicitly supplies its chosen value
and rejects passwords which cannot be represented exactly before decoding.
No Unicode-to-ACP roundtrip trick, lossy substitution or process-wide locale
change is used. RAR/7Z and other handlers retain their original password logic.
ZIP output handling is unchanged; One's ZIP writer uses minizip-ng.

The LHA handler reads level-3 headers with 32-bit extension sizes. Each full
header is limited to 1 MiB and 256 extensions; lengths and a present common
header CRC are validated before exposing entries. Level-3 modification times
are Unix times. Unix permissions extensions are exposed as PosixAttrib so
One's extraction and drag preflight can reject symbolic links.
The LHA ISetProperties "cp" property selects filename encoding independently
of ZIP password encoding. Values: 0 (use a declared 0x46 code page, otherwise
OEM default), 437, 932, 936, 949, 950, 65001. An explicit setting overrides
the header. Invalid declared Windows code pages are refused in auto mode.
Other LHA codecs, level-0/1/2 binary header reading and output handling
remain upstream; no LHA writer is added.

Rebuild: node scripts/build-sevenzip.mjs
Requires the repository's existing Visual Studio C++ x64 toolchain, Windows
tar and Git. The script verifies the pinned archive hash, extracts into work,
applies both patches and builds Format7zF with nmake PLATFORM=x64 MP_NPROC=8.
node scripts/build-archive.mjs includes this step and copies the DLL to dist.
Applications dynamically load this replaceable DLL from the helper directory.

Standalone rebuild of the provided corresponding source:
  tar -xzf 7zip-26.04-source.tar.gz --strip-components=1 -C <empty-source-dir>
  cd <empty-source-dir>
  git apply <path-to-one-password-codepage.patch>
  git apply <path-to-one-lha-headers.patch>
  call <Visual-Studio>/VC/Auxiliary/Build/vcvars64.bat
  cd CPP/7zip/Bundles/Format7zF
  nmake PLATFORM=x64 MP_NPROC=8
The resulting replaceable library is x64/7z.dll. Packaged One includes this
source capsule, patch, manifest, original licenses and modification notice in
third-party/7zip next to the application directory.
